profile.headline:
Software Engineer at Dexiom
.NET / C# Software Engineer | Backend & Full Stack Developer | ASP.NET MVC/Core | Web APIs | Angular | SQL Server | Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
I’m a Full Stack .NET Developer / Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building, maintaining, debugging, and optimizing enterprise web applications.

My core stack includes C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, Web API, .NET Framework, SQL Server, Entity Framework, DevExpress, DevExpress XPO, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Azure DevOps. I have strong experience working on business-critical systems where backend logic, APIs, database access, workflows, dashboards, and user experience all need to work reliably together.

I enjoy working on complex enterprise applications, especially backend-heavy systems that require clean business logic, stable APIs, efficient data access, and careful troubleshooting. I’m especially strong at analyzing existing systems, identifying performance bottlenecks, preserving business rules, and improving application performance without introducing regression risk.

In recent work, I have optimized slow dashboards, long-running requests, and automated jobs by improving C#/.NET data access patterns, reducing unnecessary database calls, eliminating N+1 query issues, improving paging, optimizing ORM usage, and reducing SQL profiler events, reads, and execution time.

Key strengths:
 - C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, Web API, .NET Framework
 - Backend development, REST APIs, business logic, enterprise workflows
 - SQL Server, T-SQL, query optimization, stored procedures, views, scalar functions
 - Entity Framework, Entity Framework Core, DevExpress XPO, LINQ
 - Angular, AngularJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, Bootstrap
 - Production debugging, performance optimization, request analysis
 - Enterprise systems, dashboards, automated jobs, operational tools
 - Agile development, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD

I’m open to .NET Developer, C# Developer, Backend Developer, Full Stack Developer, and Software Engineer opportunities in the United States, including remote, hybrid, full-time, contract, and contract-to-hire roles.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Working on a large enterprise application used in aircraft manufacturing operations for Bombardier/Boeing-related processes.

Develop and maintain enterprise features using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, .NET Framework, SQL Server, DevExpress, DevExpress XPO, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Angular, and Azure DevOps.
Build and improve backend features, controllers, workflows, business rules, dashboards, and data-driven modules used by engineering, manufacturing, and operational teams.
Analyze business requirements, investigate production issues, and implement solutions across backend, frontend, API, database, workflow, and reporting layers.
Optimize slow dashboards and high-traffic screens by improving C#/.NET data access patterns, ORM usage, paging, filtering, and database interactions.
Improve performance by identifying and fixing inefficient queries, N+1 issues, in-memory filtering, redundant data loading, and unnecessary database calls.
Use SQL profiling, request performance analysis, and runtime diagnostics to reduce SQL profiler events, reads, and execution time in performance-critical areas.
Achieved major performance improvements across dashboards, exports, long-running requests, and automated jobs, including reducing one automated process from over 100 minutes to approximately 5 minutes.
Implement and improve Request Performance Log dashboards to help identify slow requests, long-running actions, and user-impacting performance issues.
Refactor complex legacy code safely while preserving workflows, business rules, permissions, and expected UI behavior.
Troubleshoot production bugs involving workflows, dashboards, automated jobs, APIs, SQL queries, data synchronization, and business rule execution.
Use Azure DevOps and Git for source control, pull requests, code reviews, task tracking, release support, and collaboration.
Collaborate with developers, QA, business analysts, and stakeholders in an Agile environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Angular Material · jQuery · DevExpress · .NET Framework · ASP.NET Web API · ASP.NET MVC · Full-Stack Development · Debugging · JavaScript · SQL Server Management Studio · .NET framework · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Problem Solving · Web Services API · Bootstrap (Framework) · HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on an Internet-based system used by law enforcement agencies to manage transaction information from pawn, secondhand, precious metal, and scrap metal businesses.

Built full-stack features using C#, ASP.NET Core 5, Web API, Angular 8, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, and TypeScript.
Designed and implemented REST APIs using ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and SQL Server.
Developed frontend applications, forms, reusable components, and UI functionality using Angular and Angular Material.
Implemented authentication and authorization features using token-based authentication and ASP.NET Identity.
Investigated and resolved issues across frontend, backend, API, and database layers.
Improved maintainability by creating reusable services, components, and shared functionality.
Published applications and APIs to IIS using Web Deploy.
Used Azure DevOps and Git for task management, version control, builds, deployments, and collaboration.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the full lifecycle development of a Form Builder application using C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Angular, Entity Framework, SQL, and Agile methodologies.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework, and SQL.
Developed backend and frontend features using C#, Angular, TypeScript, Web API, Entity Framework, and Oracle SQL.
Helped structure single-page application modules to improve maintainability, reusability, and separation of concerns.
Proposed technical solutions and algorithms to improve application behavior, code organization, and long-term maintainability.
Created unit tests using Karma and Jasmine to reduce regression risk.
Used TFS for source control, task tracking, collaboration, and deployment support.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular Material · Security Protocols · .NET Framework · ASP.NET Web API · Full-Stack Development · Software Deployment · Debugging · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Problem Solving · Web Services API · Angular

positions.title: C# Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the development and maintenance of a customer portal using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, AngularJS, SQL Server, and Agile methodologies.

Developed new features and fixed production defects for a customer-facing web portal.
Built and maintained Web API services using ASP.NET.
Refactored existing code by introducing service and business logic layers to improve maintainability and separation of concerns.
Applied object-oriented programming principles and design patterns to improve application structure.
Added and maintained unit tests using NUnit to reduce regression risk.
Supported CI/CD processes using TeamCity and Jenkins.
Worked with Scrum and Kanban methodologies to deliver features, fixes, and improvements under tight business timelines.
positions.insights: Skills: Security Protocols · .NET Framework · ASP.NET Web API · ASP.NET MVC · AngularJS · Full-Stack Development · Software Deployment · Debugging · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Problem Solving · Web Services API

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Luis, Pinar del Rio, Cuba
positions.description:
Developed and maintained internal web and desktop applications for administrative, accounting, invoicing, and human resources processes.

Developed ASP.NET and WinForms applications using C#, SQL Server, and MySQL.
Built invoicing, accounting, and HR management modules.
Created and maintained database objects, queries, and stored procedures.
Created reports exported to Word and Excel formats.
Supported IIS-hosted applications and internal Windows Server environments.
Managed Windows Server 2003 environments with Active Directory integration.
Configured internal email services using MDaemon for SMTP and POP3 communication.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · C# · WinForms · Microsoft SQL Server
